shots.test: plain text offers Paste, Paste as file, Upload and paste link, Search the web, and Pin
formatted text also offers Paste as plain text and Paste as Markdown
text with spaces or blank lines around it also offers Paste trimmed
Base64 of a readable text also offers Paste decoded Base64
a text with %-codes also offers Paste URL-decoded
JSON on one line also offers Paste formatted JSON, and JSON over several lines Paste minified JSON
a colour also offers it in the other notations
a Unix time also offers Paste as date and time, and a date and time Paste as Unix time
a calculation also offers Paste result
an e-mail address also offers Write email
the path of an existing file also offers Copy file at this path and Show in file manager
an image offers Paste, Paste as file, Upload and paste link, and Pin
a text file offers Paste, Paste path, Paste file contents, Paste as compressed file and Pin
an image file offers Paste as image
several files offer the same as one file, with Paste paths
other data offers only Paste and Pin
text with links also offers the link actions
